_description: Hardware profile definitions for PAW robot sketches.
_note: Each profile defines the board, shield, servo init style, and pin namespace. Referenced by robot description files and used by codegen to produce correct sketch templates.

uno_r4_wifi__prototype.label: Uno R4 WiFi — Prototype (bare Arduino)
uno_r4_wifi__prototype._servo_note: Uses Servo.h — attach() with Arduino GPIO pin numbers
uno_r4_wifi__prototype._pin_note: Pin integers are Arduino GPIO numbers (D5=5, D6=6, A0=14, etc.)
